# Trustpoint Labs

> Trustpoint Labs provides engineering, integration, support and OEM services
> for industrial machine identity and PKI. We help manufacturers and operators
> deploy secure machine identities, automate certificate lifecycles and
> integrate industrial PKI into real OT environments.

## Home (https://trustpoint-labs.com/)

### What we solve

Connected factories increasingly depend on secure communication,
authentication and lifecycle-managed digital identities. Trustpoint brings
PKI close to devices and machines — including segmented and offline OT
networks.

- Machine identity: Establish trusted identities for industrial devices and machines.
- Certificate lifecycle: Automate enrollment, renewal and lifecycle management for device certificates.
- Industrial PKI: Connect devices and OT systems to local or enterprise PKI infrastructure.
- Device onboarding: Support manual brownfield onboarding as well as automated deployment workflows.

### Offering

Trustpoint Labs provides engineering, integration, support and OEM services
around the Trustpoint open-source platform.

1. **Engineering & Integration** — Integrate Trustpoint into your devices, applications and PKI infrastructure.
   - Device onboarding workflows
   - CMP / EST integration
   - OPC UA / GDS integration
   - Custom connectors and plugins
   - Architecture and implementation support
2. **Support & SLA** — Technical support for production deployments and operational Trustpoint environments.
   - Business-hours support
   - Incident response
   - Troubleshooting
   - Upgrade assistance
   - Hands-on engineering support
3. **OEM & White Label** — Use Trustpoint as the technology foundation for your own market-facing product.
   - White-label development
   - Embedded or containerized deployment
   - Customer-specific maintenance
   - Third-level support
   - Long-term engineering partnership

### Why Trustpoint

Machine identity management built for real-world industrial environments —
open, interoperable and designed around operational constraints.

1. OT-native architecture — Built for industrial networks and operating constraints.
2. Local, offline & edge deployment — Works without permanent cloud connectivity, including air-gapped environments.
3. Brownfield & legacy support — Integrates existing devices alongside modern automated onboarding.
4. Native OPC UA / GDS integration — Supports OPC UA certificate management and GDS workflows.
5. Open source & auditable — Transparent, reviewable and independently extensible.
6. Sovereignty & vendor independence — Open standards and local deployment help reduce vendor lock-in.

### How we work

1. Discovery — We review your devices, network architecture, PKI environment and onboarding requirements.
2. Integration — We implement Trustpoint, required protocols, connectors and customer-specific workflows.
3. Operation — We support the deployment through engineering support, maintenance or SLA services.

### Deployment models

1. Local OT Edge — Trustpoint deployed close to machines and devices inside the OT environment.
2. RA Mode — Trustpoint connects industrial OT to an authoritative enterprise PKI.
3. Local CA — Independent certificate authority for isolated, segmented or offline environments.
4. OEM Integration — Trustpoint embedded into a customer's hardware or software product.

### Open source

Trustpoint is available as open-source software under the MIT license. The
open-source foundation provides transparency, auditability and vendor
independence. Trustpoint Labs builds commercial engineering, integration,
support and OEM services around that foundation.

- GitHub: https://github.com/Trustpoint-Project

Tell us about your devices, PKI environment or integration requirements. We
can start with a technical workshop, integration sprint or pilot deployment —
early-stage requirements are completely fine.

- Contact form: https://trustpoint-labs.com/#contact

### FAQ

- **What is Trustpoint Labs?** Trustpoint Labs provides commercial engineering, integration, support and OEM services around the Trustpoint open-source platform.
- **What is Trustpoint?** Trustpoint is an open-source platform for managing digital machine identities in industrial environments. It supports local and edge deployment and certificate lifecycle workflows for industrial devices.
- **Which protocols are supported?** Trustpoint supports certificate management and enrollment workflows using technologies including CMP, EST, REST and OPC UA GDS Push.
- **Can Trustpoint run offline?** Yes. Trustpoint is designed for local and edge deployment and can operate in segmented or air-gapped OT environments without permanent cloud connectivity.
- **Is Trustpoint open source?** Yes. Trustpoint is currently distributed under the MIT license.
- **Do you offer support for production deployments?** Yes. Trustpoint Labs offers engineering support, integration assistance, maintenance and SLA-based support for commercial deployments.
